race.comment: IN CIRCLES (1) looks the horse to beat despite being beaten as a well-supported favourite at Goulburn, where she was ready to challenge but only fair late and finished sixth, beaten two and a half lengths. Her Hawkesbury third the start prior reads well for this, and two placings from two previous starts around 1460m give her a sound distance base. Well placed and should be tough to rein in. ON THE FLY (4) is still lightly raced and comes off consecutive seconds, the latest at Wagga when beaten just under a length at big odds, so she is entitled to be in the winning discussion third-up. BANNER BANNER (3) comes back from provincial company after a solid Hawkesbury third, and while the first try around 1460m is the question, barrier one gives him every chance to hold his place among the main hopes. BURNT FINGERS (6) Late work first-up was better than the margin, but she is still unplaced from eight starts and new to 1460m. Place chance here
